body.purpose: All shell text; tabular numerals on.

shadows.name: sheet
shadows.purpose: Document pages, notice and dialog over the table.

motion.name: state-fade
motion.purpose: Drop-target border and background change; disabled under reduced motion.

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Sunken field on the rail; border turns pencil on focus.

components.name: Tab
components.description: Rail tab; selected has a raised fill and a 2px pencil underline.

components.name: Zoom Ruler
components.description: Signature control: ticks every real centimetre at the current zoom, percentage at the bottom.
components.css: .ds-ruler{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;width:112px;height:32px;padding:0;border:1px solid var(--rail-line);border-radius:4px;background:var(--rail-sunken);overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer;color:var(--rail-ink)}.ds-ruler:hover{border-color:var(--rail-ink-muted)}.ds-ticks{position:absolute;inset:0;--cm:38px;--minor:19px;background:linear-gradient(var(--rail-ink-muted),var(--rail-ink-muted)) 0 0/100% 1px no-repeat,linear-gradient(to right,var(--rail-ink) 1px,transparent 1px) 1px 0/var(--cm) 10px repeat-x,linear-gradient(to right,var(--rail-ink-muted) 1px,transparent 1px) 1px 0/var(--minor) 5px repeat-x}.ds-value{position:relative;width:100%;padding-bottom:3px;text-align:center;font-weight:600;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-ruler:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--pencil);outline-offset:1px}

narrative.overview: The document lies on a quiet graphite table and the instruments sit at the edges. A 40px rail on top and a 28px status rail on the bottom frame the sheet; everything between belongs to the document.
keyCharacteristics: Two graphite rails frame a mid-grey table; the document is the brightest thing on screen.
One accent (pencil orange) for active and actionable states; one reserved highlighter for search matches.
Tabular numerals for all figures; native Windows UI typeface.
32px minimum hit targets, hairline borders, 4px radii.
Follows the OS light or dark setting; documents stay on white sheets in both.

rules.name: The One Pencil Rule
rules.body: Pencil orange appears only on active or actionable elements. It never decorates headings, backgrounds or icons at rest.

rules.name: The Reserved Highlighter Rule
rules.body: Highlighter yellow-green means "search match" and nothing else.

rules.name: The White Sheet Rule
rules.body: Rendered document pages are white in both themes; the dark theme deepens the table and rails around them, never the page.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Tabular numerals are on at the body level so every figure aligns and does not jitter.

rules.name: The Lift-Only-The-Page Rule
rules.body: Chrome stays flat; the shadow belongs to the sheet and to transient overlays.

dos: Do keep the document the brightest, largest thing on screen; chrome stays graphite.
Do spend pencil orange only on active tab, focus, selection, primary action and drop target.
Do keep every control at least 32px square.
Do add new colours as OKLCH custom properties on `:root` with a dark override, not as literals in components.
Do show figures in tabular numerals.
Do follow the OS theme and keep rendered pages white.
donts: Don't use a generic grey toolbar with a blue accent.
Don't use highlighter yellow-green for anything but search matches.
Don't add a second accent colour, gradients, or decorative ornament to the shell.
Don't put shadows on rails, tabs, buttons or fields.
